why: The same defect on the other opacity-only treatment, and worth its own entry because what it destroys is different: `fade-long` would become 'the shipped movement, but slower', which is precisely the confound it was built to rule out. Re-running issue #542's comparison with it would then credit duration for movement's effect -- the one wrong answer the treatment exists to prevent -- and its timing check would still pass, because the duration token is untouched and only the CONTENT animation moves.
killedBy: menuTransition: the SHIPPED transition is the no-flag path itself resolves the same duration and animates the same keyframes as an absent flag
